title: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation
prompt:
Design and implement multi-tenant data isolation:

Application type: [SaaS / Internal platform]
Tenants: [estimated N tenants, N rows per tenant on average]
Isolation strategy to implement: [choose one]
  Option A: Shared database, shared schema (row-level tenant_id)
  Option B: Shared database, separate schema per tenant
  Option C: Separate database per tenant

## Recommended Strategy
Based on scale and requirements: [RECOMMENDATION with justification]

## Implementation

### Database Layer (Option A — most common)
